scope: Minimal 4.14 ordinary-open redirection repair; no loader, policy, rule format, public layout or exported-symbol changes.
source_findings: The inherited path_openat block called do_last a second time with the already-open file and FILE_OPENED state, reaching the native BUG_ON guard on a successful ordinary target open.
The inherited redirect symlink loop walked new_s while storing trailing_symlink output in s.

repair.lookup_identity: d_backing_inode(filp->f_path.dentry) preserves the path inode used by SUSFS rule registration; file_inode may be a different lower inode after vfs_open/d_real on overlayfs.
repair.retry: Use the same dfd/open_flags and one full native LOOKUP_RCU, -ECHILD fallback, -ESTALE/LOOKUP_REVAL sequence per attempt. Each path_openat allocates its own file and starts opened at zero.
repair.special_paths: O_PATH, __O_TMPFILE and dfd == -1 do not enter the new ordinary-open redirect block; their existing paths are unchanged.
repair.source_open_semantics: Retains the inherited source-first open and the caller flags; this repair does not move redirection before source access or redefine create/truncate behavior.

ownership_review.external_filename: Borrowed caller reference is never putname; assigning the local pathname parameter does not change the caller reference.
ownership_review.initial_open_failure: Native cleanup and restore_nameidata run; return the original error without a redirect name or extra fput.
ownership_review.no_rule_or_uid_mismatch: Return the original opened file; helper returns NULL and no redirect reference is acquired.
ownership_review.redirect_name_allocation_failure: Return the original opened file, preserving the inherited error-pointer handling; never putname an ERR_PTR.
ownership_review.matched_rule: Acquire one getname_kernel reference, restore_nameidata has already completed, fput the original file, then reinitialize nameidata for the target.
ownership_review.target_success_or_failure: Complete native retries and restore_nameidata, then putname the internally acquired redirect filename exactly once; return the target file or target error.
ownership_review.no_chaining: A non-NULL internal redirect filename suppresses another rule lookup on the second attempt.
ownership_review.independent_review: nova_core and root reviewed filename/fput ownership, restore/set ordering and native retry semantics; no remaining finding in this change.
